_what: The owner's answers of 2026-09-14 to the five decisions put to him, written the moment they were given (memory owner-answers-must-be-written-down). Each carries his exact words and what it authorises.

decisions.means: A PAIR - Left Drawer AND Right Drawer - reconfirmed after seeing three one-sided drawings. Recorded on the ruling in drawer-side-owner-rulings.json.

decisions.topic: the 12 chains refused because their stock bucket is shared
decisions.words: 「2 怎么可能我们的库存是分item的不是吗」
decisions.means: NOT a choice - a challenge to the explanation, and a fair one. Stock is keyed (warehouse, item_code, variant_key), so it IS per item and per spec, and several orders for the same item and spec draw from ONE pool. His intuition points at the better fix: a received lot records which receipt it came in on, so an order's OWN goods can be told apart from the pool. The next step is to measure, per refused chain, whether its lots are traceable to its own receipt and untouched by any other order's consumption - and move only those, instead of refusing or splitting by guessed quantity.

decisions.topic: HC-SO-012046 / HC-SO-013224 - shipped SKUs differ from the factory's build
decisions.words: 「3 确定 from supplier 看那个 code 是正确的 然后处理掉了再做A 可是确保 stocks 是准确的」
decisions.means: Three steps in order: (1) verify against the supplier export that the supplier's code is the correct one; (2) correct the documents to it; (3) THEN make the stock adjustment - and the stock must end accurate. The adjustment must not write an OUT against stock we do not hold (docs/bugs/0722).

decisions.topic: the 4 sofa POs whose pieces differ from the supplier
decisions.means: Follow the factory. Correct our documents to the supplier's pieces, with the stock-aware discipline wherever goods are already in.

decisions.topic: `Separate Backrest Packing` is retired, 2 lines use a legacy spelling of it
decisions.words: 「5 查看有什么类似的 seperate packing for backerest 的 special 嘛 没有的话就用 1 这个」
decisions.means: First look for an ACTIVE option that means the same thing; if there is one, fold the 2 lines onto it. If there is none, re-activate `Separate Backrest Packing` and fold onto that.
